integration.precondition: Review evidence.json proposalTargets base hashes and git apply --check; merge append-only fixture additions if those base files changed. Coordinator applies after review.
integration.generatedFiles: No manifest addition required: both scenarios are new exports of existing manifest-listed fixture modules. Coordinator fixture build regenerates registry.json and public/index.json. Do not manually edit them.

runtime: Supported Node 24 (or Node 22.12+) and installed frozen workspace dependencies; use the existing validation lease once, never bypass or reclaim an occupied lease.

steps.expected: Coordinator-only fresh public package build and docs-owned fixture build/typecheck, including both appended fixture exports. Share this build with other integrated editor patches rather than rebuilding per leaf.
Browser declarations typecheck with zero diagnostics.

Six named cases per engine: long chrome in eight theme/density/locale combinations; host slot replacement; pending/unavailable states; six modal Cancel/Escape rows; link Apply at three range shapes; three host lifetime invalidations. Retain every failure and exact assertion; no retries/assertion removal.

review: Record exact source, dist, fixture output and assertion hashes, supported Node/browser versions and per-engine results.

Review all 320px light/dark, compact/comfortable English/Arabic screenshots. Check long title/status/save/menu/optional-toolbar layout, visible translated names and logical RTL order. Measured DOM geometry alone is not visual review or spoken AT.
Reuse accepted unchanged tests for 200%-text native traversal and deferred heading replacement; do not call CSS text scaling real browser zoom. Retain the old receipt's exact input/head limits.

A failing new selection assertion is an actionable acceptance finding, not proof that the test is wrong. Inspect native range and focus attachments, confirm expected public contract, then prepare a minimal fix and affected rerun.
Keep all twenty editor V leaves independently tracked; coordinator alone reconciles active A/V checklists after integration and evidence review.
remainingBeyondPreparedCases: Image/columns successful insertion at selected ranges if existing unit/native accepted rows do not cover the required host behavior; prepared cases cover cancelled ranges and invalidation, not these success outcomes.
Late asynchronous image upload success/failure uses the existing editor-upload-lifecycle receipt and tests; compare its inputs separately if changed. No new late-upload execution is claimed here.
Physical device, spoken AT, actual browser zoom and owner acceptance remain their independently tracked gates.
notRequested: Packed consumer rerun without a changed package contract
